title: Bangladesh Issues EOI to Enlist Demand Aggregators for Rooftop Solar Program
summary: Bangladesh's Infrastructure Development Company (IDCOL) has invited expressions of interest to enlist demand aggregators under its Domestic Rooftop Solar program. The program aims to install 500 MWp of rooftop solar capacity across approximately 125,000 customer establishments by February 28, 2027. Multiple demand aggregators may be enlisted to implement the program.
